chunks: Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Adib said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Shu'ayb from Jamil ibn Salih from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

"If you are able to pray one thousand rak'ahs during the day and night in the month of Ramadan and in other months, then do so, for indeed Ali (peace be upon him) used to pray one thousand rak'ahs during the day and night."
ai.seo_question: How many voluntary rak'ahs did Imam Ali pray daily according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the virtue of *Salat al-Nawafil* by citing Imam Ali’s (AS) practice of performing a thousand rak'ahs daily, establishing a high benchmark for voluntary devotion. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often interpreted not merely as a literal count but as an encouragement for consistent, substantial extra worship that complements the obligatory prayers, reflecting the Imam’s profound spiritual discipline.
